Test Scenario: Verify Add Installations form opens successfully
Test Steps: Open the Add Installations form
Expected Result: Form opens and displays Asset, Vehicle, Installed On, Installed By, Remarks, Cancel and Save controls.

Test Scenario: Verify all required fields are marked mandatory
Test Steps: Open the form and inspect required fields
Expected Result: Asset, Vehicle, Installed On and Installed By are clearly marked with * and validation is available.

Test Steps: Click the Asset dropdown
Expected Result: Asset selection list opens and available assets are displayed.

Test Steps: Click the Vehicle dropdown
Expected Result: Vehicle selection list opens and available vehicles are displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify Installed On date picker opens
Test Steps: Click the Installed On field/calendar icon
Expected Result: Date picker opens and allows a date to be selected.

Test Scenario: Verify Installed By field accepts a responsible person
Test Steps: Enter/select a valid responsible person
Expected Result: Value is accepted and displayed correctly.

Test Scenario: Verify Remarks field accepts optional text
Test Steps: Enter text in Remarks
Expected Result: Text is accepted and character counter updates.

Test Steps: Enter text into Remarks
Expected Result: Counter reaches 500/500 and no additional characters are accepted if the limit is enforced.

Test Steps: Complete all required fields and click Save
Test Data: Valid Asset, Vehicle, Date and Installed By
Expected Result: Installation record is saved successfully and appears in the installation list.

Test Steps: Click Cancel
Expected Result: Form closes without saving a new installation record.

Test Scenario: Verify form remains usable after validation errors
Test Steps: Submit form with required fields empty, then enter valid values
Expected Result: Validation messages disappear/update appropriately after the fields are corrected.

Test Scenario: Verify saved installation retains entered values
Test Steps: Create a valid installation and reopen/view it
Expected Result: Saved Asset, Vehicle, Installed On, Installed By and Remarks values are displayed correctly.

Test Scenario: Create installation with all valid required fields
Test Steps: Select valid Asset and Vehicle, enter valid date and Installed By, then Save
Expected Result: Installation is created successfully.

Test Scenario: Create installation with valid optional Remarks
Test Steps: Complete required fields and enter valid remarks, then Save
Expected Result: Installation is saved with the entered remarks.

Test Steps: Complete only required fields and click Save
Expected Result: Installation is saved successfully because Remarks is optional.

Test Steps: Enter exactly 500 characters and save with valid required fields
Expected Result: All 500 characters are accepted and installation can be saved.

Test Steps: Open Asset dropdown and select an available asset
Expected Result: Selected asset is displayed in the Asset field.

Test Steps: Open Vehicle dropdown and select an available vehicle
Expected Result: Selected vehicle is displayed in the Vehicle field.

Test Steps: Open date picker and select a valid permitted date
Expected Result: Selected date is displayed in Installed On.

Test Steps: Enter/select a valid responsible person
Expected Result: Installed By value is accepted without validation error.

Test Scenario: Save installation with minimum valid data
Test Steps: Fill all mandatory fields with valid values and leave Remarks empty
Expected Result: Record is created successfully.

Test Scenario: Submit form with all required fields empty
Test Steps: Open form and click Save
Expected Result: Save is prevented and validation messages are displayed for Asset, Vehicle, Installed On and Installed By.

Test Steps: Fill all fields except Asset and click Save
Expected Result: Save is prevented and 'Asset is required' validation is displayed.

Test Steps: Fill all fields except Vehicle and click Save
Expected Result: Save is prevented and 'Vehicle is required' validation is displayed.

Test Steps: Fill all fields except Installed On and click Save
Expected Result: Save is prevented and 'Installed date is required' validation is displayed.

Test Steps: Fill all fields except Installed By and click Save
Expected Result: Save is prevented and 'Installed by is required' validation is displayed.

Test Scenario: Enter more than 500 characters in Remarks
Test Steps: Enter more than 500 characters in Remarks
Expected Result: Input beyond the supported 500-character limit is rejected/truncated and the counter does not exceed 500/500.

Test Steps: Enter spaces/newlines in Remarks and submit
Expected Result: System should handle whitespace according to validation rules and should not store unintended whitespace as meaningful remarks.

Test Scenario: Attempt Save by repeatedly clicking Save
Test Steps: Complete valid form and rapidly click Save multiple times
Expected Result: Only one installation record is created; duplicate submissions are prevented.

Test Scenario: Attempt to save after invalid required-field correction
Test Steps: Submit empty form, correct only some fields, then click Save
Expected Result: Save remains blocked and validation remains for the missing required fields.

Test Steps: Enter values in the form and click Cancel
Expected Result: Form closes without creating an installation record; if discard confirmation is implemented, it is displayed.

Test Steps: Attempt to submit with an invalid or unavailable Asset value
Expected Result: System prevents invalid Asset from being saved and displays appropriate validation/error feedback.

Test Steps: Attempt to submit with an invalid or unavailable Vehicle value
Expected Result: System prevents invalid Vehicle from being saved and displays appropriate validation/error feedback.

Test Steps: Enter an unsupported/invalid value if the field permits free text
Expected Result: System rejects the value or displays appropriate validation feedback according to the field's business rule.

Test Scenario: Select an invalid installation date if business rules restrict dates
Test Steps: Attempt to select/enter a prohibited date
Test Data: Invalid/future/past date depending on business rule
Expected Result: System prevents prohibited dates or displays an appropriate validation message.

Test Steps: Fill valid form and simulate server/API failure during Save
Expected Result: User receives a clear error message, form data is not silently lost, and no false success is shown.

Test Steps: Fill valid form, expire session, then click Save
Expected Result: Save fails safely and user is redirected/asked to authenticate as appropriate; no duplicate or partial record is created.

Test Scenario: Attempt duplicate installation if duplicate business rule applies
Test Steps: Create the same installation combination again
Expected Result: System rejects the duplicate if duplicates are not allowed and provides meaningful feedback.

Test Steps: Enter a script/XSS payload in Remarks and save
Expected Result: Script is treated as text/safely encoded and is not executed.

Test Scenario: Enter SQL-like payload in text field
Test Steps: Enter SQL injection test string where applicable
Expected Result: Input is safely handled and does not alter/query unintended records.
